name: Aérospatiale/BAC Concorde
summary: The Anglo-French supersonic airliner that flew at Mach 2 for 27 years: an ogival delta wing, four Olympus engines with reheat in paired nacelles, and a nose that droops for take-off and landing.

still.gauges: the main instrument panel is a 2D panel in FlightGear, so the 3D flight deck has no gauges to move
